melee.authority: Martial Arts and Chi module content imported into the current ruleset

archmage.authority: Approved Archmage additions imported into already-supported magic schools

chi.note: Chi schools and techniques are generated together with Chi development from one Master of Melee Raw IR pass.

magic_equipment.note: Core spell cards and gear tables are generated from DUBL 3.69; approved Archmage additions are generated from the Archmage module. Conflicting duplicate spell cards remain incomplete and locally overridable.

skill_effects.note: Rule text/provenance comes from source-generated Development entries; mode/targets/toggle semantics are tracked application annotations, not rulebook authority.

skills.note: Rulebook-generated mechanics plus tracked persistence/UI bindings. Current native Archmage Runology explicitly uses the ordinary skill table and Intellect. Unspecified Auto6/Auto12/untrained semantics remain unspecified.

development_regular.note: Regular Development mechanics are generated from DUBL 3.69. Bindings contain only stable/structural metadata and explicit compatibility fallbacks for fields absent from the source.

development_special.note: Special-branch child mechanics are generated from DUBL 3.69; bindings retain stable/structural metadata and explicit fallbacks for source omissions.

development_ability_roots.note: Root ability-access nodes are generated from DUBL 3.69 ability source tables. Empty template fields and draft sources remain incomplete and locally overridable.

development_martial.note: Martial Arts styles and techniques are generated from the Master of Melee module Raw IR.

development_chi.note: Chi progression/development entries are generated from the Master of Melee module.

development_magic.note: Magic Development skills are generated from the core DUBL 3.69 Magic/Magical Skills section.

development_native_supplement.note: Explicit exact native occurrence bindings recover missing core cards; omitted source rank maxima remain unresolved in strict acquisition.

semanticAudit.note: Structural validation does not mean all known rulebook contradictions are resolved; semantic audit findings become blocking diagnostics during domain promotion.

policy.ambiguity: Import source content and emit diagnostics; never invent executable semantics.
policy.conflicts: Require an explicit resolution with decision and rationale before executable promotion.
policy.runtime: Generated/validated ruleset content is consumed by shared code; Android and Desktop must not own rule copies.
